title: Item:Supply Crate Order

== Supply Crate Order == [[File:Supply Crate Order.png|right|upright|420px|Supply Crate Order]] Use this special item to summon a supply crate somewhere in your challenge. Supply crates contain potent power-ups that will help you in your challenge.
They may also contain various other useful items. Usable in extraction and collection challenges. * Acquired by: ** {{Verified|Killing boss monsters in any challenge. (~4-5% chance for them to drop a random challenge item)}}, [[Bound to Character]]. ** Purchase from the [[DDOstore/Gear and Equipment#Challenge Tools|DDO Store]], [[Bound to Account]]. Usable in the following extraction challenges: * '''Kobold Island:''' ** [[Kobold Island: Kobold Chaos|Kobold Chaos]] ** [[Kobold Island: The Disruptor|The Disruptor]] ** [[Kobold Island: The Disruptor - EPIC|The Disruptor - EPIC]] ** [[Kobold Island: Short Cuts|Short Cuts]] ** [[Kobold Island: Short Cuts - EPIC|Short Cuts - EPIC]] ==See also== * [[Challenges]] * [[DDO Store]] [[Category:DDO Store items]] [[Category:Challenge items]]
